source.title: Dynamical percolation: Early results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/1195777 for document identifier 1195777. The zbMATH REST API resolved the exact record to Olle Haeggstroem, 'Dynamical percolation: Early results and open problems', Zbl 0906.60081, pages 59-74 in Microsurveys in Discrete Probability, DIMACS Series in Discrete Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science 41, AMS, 1998. DBLP and DOI resolution identify the exact DOI as 10.1090/DIMACS/041/05.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. Direct access to the zbMATH web page produced a Cloudflare challenge, while the zbMATH API provided bibliographic metadata only. The DOI redirects to https://www.ams.org/dimacs/041, which was blocked by Cloudflare in the local fetch context. The AMS bookstore page, DIMACS archive page, DBLP record, and the author's publication list identify the same work but expose only metadata, table-of-contents entries, or citation information rather than the full chapter text.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier 1195777, Zbl identifier 0906.60081, exact title, DOI 10.1090/DIMACS/041/05, first author, DBLP key conf/dimacs/Haggstrom97, DIMACS volume metadata, and exact-title PDF searches. Candidate pages included DBLP, DIMACS, AMS, the author's publication list, a book-review PDF, ResearchGate/CiteSeerX copies of a later survey by Jeffrey E. Steif, and unrelated or citing papers. These candidates were rejected because they were metadata-only, paywalled or blocked, reviews, related surveys, snippets, or different works, not a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the open-problem statements.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, DOI metadata, DBLP records, DIMACS or AMS table-of-contents pages, author publication lists, book reviews, search snippets, related surveys, or citing papers.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim open-problem quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-1195777.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
